result.summary: Wrapped the `Files.walk` call in `VEDeviceDiscoverer.getDevicesFromPath` in a try-with-resources over a `Stream<Path>` so the directory-walk stream (and its OS file handle) is always closed, and added the required `java.util.stream.Stream` import. The working tree had no pre-existing uncommitted work for this slug.

result.summary: Replaced every fixed-size-metadata FSDataInputStream#read call in LogAggregationIndexedFileController with readFully (checksum-file node-name reads in initializeWriterInRolling, parseCheckSumFiles and parseChecksum; the UUID read in loadIndexedLogsMeta; the UUID read in loadUUIDFromLogFile) and dropped the now-dead short-read guards (actualLength == nameLength, uuidReadLen != UUID_LENGTH, the array.length != offset "Error on loading log meta" throw) plus the "the length of loaded UUID:{}" debug line. Short reads now surface as EOFException instead of being silently reinterpreted as complete-but-mismatched data.
result.notes: A previous interrupted run had already made most of this change uncommitted in the working tree; I reviewed it, kept it, and only tidied parseChecksum so nodeName/index are declared at their assignment instead of pre-declared uninitialized. No test changes: the upstream JIRA (YARN-10320) is a code-only refactor and the existing TestLogAggregationIndexedFileController has no references to the removed messages/variables (verified by grep for "Error on loading log meta", actualLength, uuidReadLen). Behaviour note worth flagging: in parseCheckSumFiles the surrounding catch(IOException) still skips the file, but in initializeWriterInRolling and loadUUIDFromLogFile a truncated checksum/log file now propagates EOFException instead of being silently skipped/deleted — that matches upstream. Imports (Charset, StandardCharsets, Arrays, IOException) are all still used; only this one file was touched.
